turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dear customer, this is an urgent call regarding your credit card renewal.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your card has been flagged for mandatory KYC update or it will be deactivated today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please read out your 16-digit card number and the CVV on the back.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Now tell me the one time password received on SMS to complete the process.
